# ui::LottieIconSource

Header: `winui/ui/media/AnimatedVisuals.hpp`.

Derives from `ui::AnimatedIconSource`.

The base of the stock animated icons. Each is 48x48 DIPs, and [render_frame()](#render_frame) draws it in opaque black.

Every stock source is stateless, so one instance can serve any number of icons. [AnimatedIcon](../controls/animated-icon.md#uianimatedicon) calls [render_icon_frame()](../rendering/animated-icon-source.md#render_icon_frame) with its own foreground color. An [AnimatedVisualPlayer](../controls/animated-visual-player.md#uianimatedvisualplayer) calls [render_frame()](#render_frame).

Example: 
```cpp
static const ui::AnimatedSettingsVisualSource settings;

auto icon = std::make_unique<ui::AnimatedIconControl>();
icon->set_source(&settings);
icon->set_fallback(ui::IconGlyph{0xE713}); // the static settings glyph
icon->set_state("Normal");

// Or play the whole animation in a player:
auto player = std::make_unique<ui::AnimatedVisualPlayerControl>();
player->set_source(&settings);
```

## natural_size

```cpp
Size natural_size() const override
```

Always 48x48 DIPs.

## render_frame

```cpp
void render_frame(Renderer& renderer, const Rect& bounds, double progress) const override
```

Draws the frame at `progress` (0..1) in opaque black.
